g.text: Common pattern (each row is a standard result in its own setting): Q = ‖Φ·‖² + (indefinite boundary/charge term), with ‖·‖ from an INDEPENDENT positive structure.

g.text: Arithmetic target (OPEN, not constructed): Φ: E0 → H₊ built from Euler factors + Γ data, scaling-equivariant, window-consistent,
